identity.name: Absent Atlas
identity.summary: An open black atlas surrounding a pale square hole.
identity.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 12 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 2 doom through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: Every route ends in the same unwritten country.

effects.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 12 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 2 doom through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its void trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Hollow Bookmark, Pearl of Brine, Salt Lantern into Absent Atlas.

visual.brief: An open black atlas surrounding a pale square hole.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; deliberate spell element colors; no incidental rim light.
